summary: H World Group Limited filed a Form 6-K announcing the pricing of CNY3.35 billion aggregate principal amount of 2.25% CNY-denominated senior unsecured bonds due 2031, offered offshore under Regulation S to non-U.S. persons. The company, acting as issuer, expects to close on or about September 16, 2026, subject to customary conditions, with net proceeds earmarked for general corporate purposes. The bonds are expected to list on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange and are not registered under the Securities Act. This is a routine debt financing, structurally akin to a US investment-grade note offering, not a special situation; watch for final pricing, settlement, and any use-of-proceeds updates.
